page_title: STU 2-0 WER | Stuttgart v Werder Bremen 02/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+4' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) didn't manage to convert the resulting corner kick into a goal. He produced a header from a dangerous position inside the box, but his attempt went well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Stuttgart.
90+4' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) prepares to take a corner kick.

90+4' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception. The linesman points to the corner flag, Werder Bremen are going to take it.

90+3' Michael Zetterer (Werder Bremen) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball down to the middle of the goal. Alexander Nubel pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
90+3' Werder Bremen work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

90+3' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) finds himself some space just outside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Alexander Nubel pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going inside the right post.
90+2' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

90+2' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Werder Bremen.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Substitution. Anthony Rouault (VfB Stuttgart) in, Pascal Stenzel out.
89' Ole Werner decides to make a substitution. Jens Stage will be replaced by Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen).
89' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Dawid Kownacki (Werder Bremen) comes onto the pitch so that Rafael Borre can be given a rest.
88' Alexander Nubel pulls off a great save to deny Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) who, makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive towards the middle of the goal.
86' Pascal Stenzel (VfB Stuttgart) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Bastian Dankert had an easy-decision to make.

85' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) misses a sitter from inside the six-yard box after striking the ball towards goal and it goes narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Stuttgart will have a goal kick.
83' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) sends a precise pass into the box, but Woo-Yeong Jeong loses the one-on-one with the defender.
82' Woo-Yeong Jeong (VfB Stuttgart) serves up a nice cross, but Michael Zetterer punches the ball away.
82' Woo-Yeong Jeong (VfB Stuttgart) sends a cross into the box, but Michael Zetterer comes off his line to gather the ball.
80' Werder Bremen take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
79' Werder Bremen can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. Werder Bremen earn a corner.
79' Sebastian Hoeness prepares a substitution. Chris Fuhrich is replaced by Woo-Yeong Jeong (VfB Stuttgart).
79' Silas goes off the pitch and Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) comes on.
78' Rafael Borre (Werder Bremen) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Werder Bremen have been awarded a corner kick.
75' 2 - 0 Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) sends Michael Zetterer the wrong way and fires the penalty into the middle of the goal!
74' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
72' One of the Werder Bremen players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul. It's a penalty! What an opportunity to score for Stuttgart.
71' Here comes a substitution. Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) is brought on as a substitute for Felix Agu.
71' Substitution. Deniz Undav will be replaced by Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart).
71' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) replacing Maximilian Mittelstadt.
70' Enzo Millot picks out Silas (VfB Stuttgart) unmarked inside the box, but his strike goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
68' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
67' A cross into the box picks out Felix Agu (Werder Bremen), who steps inside his marker and fizzes a shot high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Stuttgart will have a goal kick.
67' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) is able to continue to play.
65' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
65' Silas (VfB Stuttgart) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
63' Here is a change. Marvin Ducksch is going off and Ole Werner gives the last tactical orders to Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen).
63' Substitution. Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Milos Veljkovic walks off.
62' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
61' Wow, what an escape. Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. The ball is out of play. Stuttgart will have a chance to score from a corner.
59' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
59' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Werder Bremen force their opponents to concede a corner.
58' Werder Bremen keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
55' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.

53' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) loses his marker in the box from the resulting corner, times his jump well but flashes his close-range header well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
53' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) will deliver the corner kick.
52' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart). The ball goes out for a corner. Stuttgart can continue in their attacking effort.

52' A sweet pass inside the box gives Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance! The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
51' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) meets a cross inside the box, but Michael Zetterer wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
49' Werder Bremen failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
49' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) inside the box. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Werder Bremen.
48' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.

47' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Bastian Dankert has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Stuttgart.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

45+1' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) unleashed a rocket of a shot aiming towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save. Good work from Stuttgart as they win a corner.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' Pascal Stenzel (VfB Stuttgart) collects a pass and has an effort from distance to the bottom left corner, but Michael Zetterer answers with a superb save to deny him.
43' Silas (VfB Stuttgart) fires the ball on goal but sends it into orbit. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
42' Dan-Axel Zagadou (VfB Stuttgart) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Bastian Dankert blows for a foul.

40' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) doesn't hesitate to shoot inside the box after a neat pass from Silas. It's a good effort but just misses the left post. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
39' Some great controlled play and passing from Stuttgart. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
35' Rafael Borre (Werder Bremen) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him.
34' Silas (VfB Stuttgart) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked.
33' Werder Bremen players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
30' Total attempts – 8:0.
29' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
27' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
24' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.

23' It looks like Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) saw red with that tackle. Bastian Dankert won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Stuttgart.
21' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
20' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart).

20' He should have scored! Silas (VfB Stuttgart) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block. Stuttgart force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
17' 1 - 0 Goal! 1:0. Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) taps home from almost on the goal line after a lucky rebound fell at his feet.
17' Waldemar Anton (VfB Stuttgart) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the bottom left corner and forces a good save out of Michael Zetterer.
14' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
14' Silas (VfB Stuttgart) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Stuttgart win a corner.
13' Rafael Borre (Werder Bremen) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball goes out of play and Stuttgart will have a goal kick.
11' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
11' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) and Deniz Undav combine well with a quick one-two to trick their opponent.

10' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) finds some space to control the ball from the corner and shoots, but his attempt goes way wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
9' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
9' Silas (VfB Stuttgart) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Stuttgart have been awarded a corner kick.
6' Silas (VfB Stuttgart) latches onto a short pass from Maximilian Mittelstadt inside the box, but clips his shot well wide of the left post.

6' Pascal Stenzel (VfB Stuttgart) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball has crossed the sideline. Werder Bremen are taking a throw-in.

3' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) makes a good run into the box to meet a cross and fires the ball in on goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender.
1' Rafael Borre (Werder Bremen) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Werder Bremen will take the kick-off.
Bastian Dankert got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
